{{Quote|I think I've told you all about my hand-to-hand instructor in the commandos, the one who could throw me around as though I were a dust rag without even letting me see her sweat.|Kell Tainer on Vula Nelprin|<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" />}}
'''Vula Nelprin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] hand-to-hand combat [[Instructor/Legends|instructor]] for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. She was the sister of [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Shalla Nelprin]], and the daughter of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] intelligence officer [[Vyn Narcassan]]. She also served as a hand-to-hand combat instructor for [[Kell Tainer]] when he served in the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]].<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" /> She eventually [[Marriage/Legends|married]] and had a son named [[Wran Narcassan]], who was at odds with his [[Wran Narcassan's father|father]]. Deeming his father an unsuitable role model, Wran changed his last name in honor of Vula's father Vyn.<ref name="MK" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|I’m not surprised. I remember Shalla in the field. And she said her sister&mdash;Wran's mother&mdash;was even better.|Voort saBinring, about Vula Nelprin|<ref name="MK" />}}
Vula Nelprin was a skilled hand-to-hand combat instructor who could effortlessly overpower trained commandos, reportedly throwing Kell Tainer around "like a rag doll" without breaking a sweat.<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" /> Her sister Shalla, an equally capable hand-to-hand fighter, once said that Vula was better than her.<ref name="MK" />
